A new English translation of the Persian passage supplied for this experience. “Caught in love” renders دچار, carrying both love and affliction. This is an excerpt from The Traveler, not the complete long poem.
The poet & the painter
سهراب سپهری

Sohrab
Sepehri.

1928 — 1980 · Iran

A poet who painted. A painter who listened.

Sohrab Sepehri was an Iranian poet and painter. In his work, the natural world becomes a way of looking closely at life: a tree, a little fish, the warmth of an apple.

The Traveler (مسافر) was published in 1966. This experience follows the passage shared here, from a conversation over apples and tea to the river’s thousand and one knots.
